DECISION: reach-target-matched-conditions-decision-20261024
Author: the overseer, acting under the operator's October13 delegation.

Resolve the returned conditions as follows. The two496250-to496256 branches, common900second limit,300seconds per trainer including complete save,100second save reserve, OFF-first dependency and no production adoption remain unchanged. No launch until focused independent review and exact admission succeed. Continue preparation now; these decisions need no operator relay.

C1: authorize the narrow reviewed training_preflight.py extension for these TWO named routes only, using final post-repair fingerprints and command hashes. Do not install the current draft's stale fingerprints. Preserve all prior routes, history, failed records and one-use enforcement; no general admission bypass. Main-file application must follow normal permissions. Check the draft's from_commit d6a12e... against what that field actually means; do not blindly copy a predecessor identity into the new source binding. Record final branch commit, source hashes, owner/reader hashes, command and decision identities before use. Review the actual final diff and refusal cases, not just the design.

C2: bind OFF only to reach-target-matched-launch-decision-20261024, with this amendment. ON gets the separately sent reach-target-matched-on-authority-20261024. Do not weaken the one-decision/one-block rule. Both remain one experiment with one cumulative budget; separate records do not create extra attempts or time.

C3: approve a route-specific owner_bound alternative to the long-window watcher, only for these six-step comparison routes. Existing long-run routes retain their watcher requirements. Explicitly record the exception: no full50step statistical window is available, so no long-window convergence claim. Pin the reviewed owner identity and300/100limits to the route; changing metadata alone must not admit an arbitrary owner. Keep immediate nonfinite/fault/reset/capture/identity checks and complete-save verification. The preflight gates remain honestly FAIL for normal training; any bounded exception is represented separately, not forged PASS.

C4: do NOT accept an ineffective graceful-stop request as satisfying preservation. Authorize a narrow trainer change to poll its existing control request at every MODEL-step boundary for these two runs, before another update/physics step. Preserve the existing default cadence for other runs; use a scoped explicit option if needed and pin it identically in OFF and ON. Do not change optimizer updates, planning or physics cadence. Confirm a stop issued after496250 is read at the next boundary and follows the existing complete snapshot-and-stop path; no busy polling inside an optimizer/physics call. Owner requests stop before its100second save reserve is consumed. A hung step can still defeat graceful save; the hard300second limit remains and an incomplete save stops the chain with an unsuccessful result, never adoption. Review/check this path with a small controlled test, not a new training trial.

C5: choose(b). Record hashes of ACTUAL state read back from each restored world before any treatment step, not hashes merely of the supplied serialized payload. Cover qpos/qvel/act/mocap plus restored RNG/caregiver and other continuation fields supported by the existing full-state snapshot API. Document any excluded nondeterministic bookkeeping. Use deterministic serialization preserving array dtype/shape and named fields; hash per world with a field manifest so mismatch is explainable. No simulation advance, RNG draw or learned-state update from recording. Verify readback has no such side effects. Missing/incomplete readback fails P7; do not relax it to sensory tokens. Both branches use the same amended trainer commit. Final state-recording and polling changes legitimately require new fingerprints ONCE, after review.

C6: accept the existing owner claim -> one-use admission note -> trainer start -> segment_finish mechanism, with exact claim/process identity and resource class. Review the failure paths: admission failure means no trainer; OFF failure/incomplete save means no ON; all rows receive truthful completion status and retained logs. No wrapper bypass of resource or lifecycle refusal.

C7: accept trainer commit='unknown' with explicit owner-attested commit and exact source-file hashes, clean worktree verification and immutable launch receipts. Do not rewrite 'unknown' as trainer-reported identity. No new global or process Git trust configuration is requested by this decision; use the already authorized owner identity mechanism. If that mechanism itself is refused, report rather than evade it.

C8: the ONE authorized exact installer-staging cleanup remains valid if still unused, under its original immediate rechecks and normal permissions. No second removal or machine-settings change is added here. Recheck disk/memory before each branch. Record any prelaunch clock suspension; active run clocks never pause.

Proceed with one focused review of these deltas integrated with the in-progress owner/reader review. No broad suites or repeated repair review. Seal the final package and bind the two reviewed exact command fingerprints; if all stated conditions pass, the prior conditional execution authority applies without another signature round. Any material departure or unresolved required review finding returns here. Send final package/launch receipt or concrete unresolved defect. r2 held. Page update acknowledged as reported.
